name: No rugs: the king on the bathroom wall, a nightstand and a floating shelf under matching wall lamps, a pine bench at its foot
notes:
Rug-free (F-66), 2026-10-24, re-staged 2026-10-25 with a: the staged king layout with no rug, for dust and dust mites. Andrew: "keep the rug / carpet version. But my wife is suggesting we don't use carpets so we don't worry about dust / mites as much." 13 placed, 11 extras. In this room it is the stronger plan: a rug under the king can reach only 9.25" past each side (a, rug-1).
What replaced the TIOKRONA: the bed is the anchor, framed by the white VIHALS and the white floating shelf at one height under matching bamboo wall lamps (light at the bed, F-66 2), and the PJÄTTERYD over it, 55" over 75.5", 73%, near the two thirds F-66 asks for (3); the pine bench across its foot and the pine frame carry the jute's natural tone, with the bamboo of the lamps, and the palette moves up off the floor into the bedding and textiles (4): the natural ÄNGSLILJA cover, the VALLKRASSING gray-green throw and cushion covers, the BENGTA panels. Machine-washable by their pages: the VALLKRASSING covers (warm), the FJÄDRAR inserts (warm, to 60°C) and the SMÅSPORRE King insert (60°C, which its page says eliminates dust mites); the VILDKORN pillows "can be washed frequently at high temperatures"; the ÄNGSLILJA, DVALA, BENGTA and the throw need their care labels read. The rug's second zone, the floor out to the reading chair, keeps its own light, the TÅGARP, with the side table and the plant (5). Softness underfoot is the one job nothing replaces: slippers by the bed. With the floor bare, the whole room mops in one pass.
A king fits one way only: headboard end on the right (bathroom) wall, between 24" off the heater's face for getting in (y 27, F-34; the face is 3" off the wall, F-33) and the bathroom door's 30" landing (y 103, F-31): 76", a king mattress exactly. The Mellow pine platform (75.5"; its mattress overhangs it 1/4" a side) is the narrowest king in the catalog and the only one that fits it; the Yaheetech dark-walnut king (amazon-B0DWMSPBMZ, 78.5") would leave 21.5" on the window side, the TARVA King (79 1/8") 20.9" and the MALM King (82 1/4") 17.75" (tight, F-34). The floor beside the head is the nightstand's on the window side and the bathroom landing's on the other, so the bathroom side's nightstand is a LACK wall shelf at the same height.
bed-1 Mellow king platform, natural pine (floor): right wall, rot 90, x 97.5-177, y 27.25-102.75, its mattress y 27-103. F-34: the window side 24" from the heater's face to the mattress (24.25" to the frame) along its whole length, since the heater runs the whole wall (24" min, 30" preferred), and 27" from the wall; the bathroom side 30" from the mattress to the bottom wall, across the bathroom door's landing (F-31, assumed-position:door). F-33: bedding 24" from the heater's face (12" min). No headboard: the pillows rest against the wall under the art.
nightstand-1 VIHALS nightstand, white, 14 5/8" square and 22 7/8" tall (floor): the window side of the head, rot 90, x 162.375-177, y 11.625-26.25, 1" off the frame and 8.625" off the heater's face (F-33: 6" min); its top 1 3/8" above the mattress's 21 1/2". The getting-in side runs from it to the foot, 64.9" long. shelf-1 LACK wall shelf, white (top): the bathroom side of the head, x 166.75-177, y 103.75-115.5, 1" off the frame, mounted with its top at 22 7/8", level with the VIHALS. It takes no floor, though its outer 2.25" (x 166.75-169) hangs over the bathroom landing's corner at knee height (F-31). Anchored for 6.5 lb (IKEA), with corner guards, since Maddie will pull on it: a phone, a cup, a book. night-light-1 TÖVÄDER battery night light (top) on it, x 168-171, y 106.6-112.6, beside the bathroom door, on its 8-hour timer: the glow for the night walk to the bathroom, about 18' around the bench for the window-side sleeper, with no cord. Two different whites at one height under matching lamps read as a pair.
lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top): on the head wall, mirrored about the bed's center line, x 172-177, y 16.9-23.9 (over the VIHALS) and 106.1-113.1 (over the shelf), hung about 24" above the mattress, beside the pillows. Their light is a soft glow (5.9 W): bedside light, not a reading light; a swing-arm reading lamp for each side is still to find. Plug-in on a 7' 3" cord: about 45" goes down to the floor, leaving about 40" along the head wall in a cord cover, so each needs an outlet within about 40" of it, or a short extension in the cover (where the outlets are is still open), never run down past the heater. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the bed, centered, x 176-177, y 37.5-92.5: 73% of the bed's width, 13.6" from each lamp; with no headboard it acts as one, so its bottom edge hangs 48" off the floor, about 6" above the propped pillows, on two hooks.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine bench (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 84.5-95.5, y 45.3-84.7, centered on the bed and 2" off it, so the duvet hangs free: pine with the pine frame, a seat and blanket storage.
chair-1 POÄNG (floor): the reading corner where the dresser stood, left wall, rot 270, x 0-32.25, y 21-47.75, facing the bed. F-33: upholstery 18" from the heater's face (12" min). floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): beside it in the window-side corner, x 0-9, y 12-21; F-33: 9" from the heater's face; its 3' 3" cord along the left wall behind the POÄNG, never to the heater wall. side-table-1 LACK side table, white stained oak effect (floor): at the chair's right arm, left wall, rot 270, x 0-21.6, y 48.75-70.4, for a cup and a book; plant-1 FEJKA areca palm on it (top), x 1.5-6.25, y 64-68.75.
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels. F-31: 3" to the side of the closet's 36" landing (assumed-position:closet); anchor-required (F-21: 76").
Walkways (F-30): from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 31.8" between the bench and the BESTÅ column, then 30" beside the bed, from the mattress to the bottom wall, the bathroom landing's depth (36" preferred: the 6" went to the window side), with nothing on that wall; 52.25" between the reading chair and the bench (62.9" from the side table) up to the window side, and 42.3" between the bench's top end and the heater's face; the closet's 36" landing and the bathroom door's 30" stay clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:door).
Extras: the king's VALEVÅG King mattress x1 (ships rolled, F-22), DVALA King sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE King insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA King cover set, natural x1, VILDKORN Queen pillows x2 (the DVALA King's cases are 20x36, king pillows; none in the catalog), FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window), and the PURRPINGLA laundry bag x1 in the walk-in closet, with the clothes.
Not placed: a dresser (the walk-in closet holds the clothes; the STORKLINTA is in b to g); a floor nightstand on the bathroom side (the door's landing); the NISSEDAL mirror ikea-30503778 (glass with no safety film on its page, F-21, and on the bottom wall it narrowed the 30" walk to the bathroom to 29": a dressing mirror for inside the walk-in closet, with a safety film, is still to choose); the STORSEGEL table lamps (12" tall: too low to read by; the wall lamps replace them); the Yaheetech, TARVA and MALM kings (each leaves the window side under 24", above). The TIOKRONA and its underlays (F-66: no textile rug).
Total $1,745.78: placed $926.89 + extras $818.89, the staged king less the $129.99 TIOKRONA and its $29.98 underlays; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-24, all of them stale today (price-stale, F-02). Before the audit of 2026-10-25, $1,825.78; with two LACK shelves, before that day, $1,793.78.
Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, anchor-required (storage-1).
Audit 2026-10-24: the same fixes as a. Rug-free check: zone, anchor and color are replaced (above); of the textiles, the POÄNG's Knisa cushion is the one dust holder its page says to vacuum and wipe, not wash. 2026-10-25: re-staged with a for the 3" heater and the 30" bathroom landing, with the same audit fixes (no glass mirror, the hamper in the closet, the night light, the bench off the bed). Window stops: the bed's foot end lies beside the window (assumed-position:window), and Maddie climbs. New York City's window-guard rule covers buildings with three or more apartments, not this two-family house, so ask the landlord for window stops on the upstairs windows.
